thread:
Priya: Heads-up - Aurora Health agreed to a short customer vignette for the upcoming benchmarks webinar. We need interview logistics, legal clearance for the quote, and a concrete embargo window. Draft brief: https://intranet.redwood/aurora-vignette (request access if blocked)

Noah: Nice. I can schedule the interview. Do we want a remote screen-share demo clip during the webinar?

Avery: Prefer a 20-min interview + optional 3-min demo clip. Demo requires demo NDA addendum per Legal. Also want a one-liner about cost reduction and one technical line about latency.

Priya: Timeline note: webinar date = 2024-12-04. Legal needs final quotes by 2024-11-25. Marketing needs final approved copy by 2024-11-27 to build slides and social.

Zoe (Legal): Add me to the doc and highlight exact quote sentences. Legal checks: consent to publish metrics, embargo end, and any customer logos. Send formal approval to agreements@redwood.com. Redaction window = 48h on customer redline requests.

Noah: Added interview slots in the doc (slots on Mon/Wed next week). Sending calendar invite to Aurora contact (kay.aurora@customer.com). Recording OK? :camera_with_flash:

Priya: Recording is fine. Please capture local audio + transcript. Mark any PII and flag lines that reference PHI; Zoe will need to check those carefully.

Avery: Ops numbers request: we need 95th pct latency, cost per 1k tokens, and cluster config (gpus + quantization). Ops, can you validate?

OpsBot: Looping in infra-owner Lila (lila.ops). Lila will paste verified numbers into the doc and sign off.

Lila (via OpsBot): Verified numbers posted - 95p latency 210ms, cost ~$0.85/1k tokens (post-batching). See table in doc.

Zoe: Noted. If metrics are customer-provided, we require a short attestation sentence from their ops lead (e.g., "we confirm these numbers reflect our production workload"). Can you get that during the interview or via email?

Noah: I'll ask Kay to include a one-line attestation and to approve the quoted numbers on email.

Priya: Lead routing post-publish: route inbound leads to SFDC queue `CS-Launch-Wave1`, tag contact with `case:aurora-vignette`, and set nurture = healthcare-segment. Noah, Sam (ops) will you confirm webhooks?

OpsBot: Webhook is set: POST /webhooks/lead-intake with payload `{"source":"case_aurora_vignette","priority":"high"}`. HubSpot flow `HS-Launch-Healthcare` will be attached.

Avery: One thing - customer asked to embargo social for 2 weeks after webinar. Proposed embargo end = 2024-12-18. Zoe, OK?

Zoe: Legal OK with 2024-12-18 embargo, provided attestation and logo permissions received by 2024-11-25. If redlines come back, 48-hour turnaround required to keep timeline.

Priya: Great. Noah will confirm interview slot and collect attestation. I'll own the copy and social assets. Keeping this thread as the single timeline. :sparkles:
